description: Structured failure taxonomy for MCP server installations. Agents use this to self-diagnose and recover from install failures.
source: Suggested by @alexshev on dev.to — 'the stronger metric is whether users can connect, run a first workflow, and know what failed'

NETWORK.user_action: Check if marketnow.site is up at /api/health

NETWORK_TIMEOUT.agent_action: reduce timeout and try alternative endpoint

AUTH.agent_action: request credentials from user or mandate
AUTH.user_action: Provide API key or wallet address

PAYMENT.description: Payment required — skill is not free
PAYMENT.agent_action: check mandate balance, request payment approval
PAYMENT.user_action: Add funds to mandate or choose a free alternative

PAYMENT_FAILED.agent_action: do not retry automatically, notify principal
PAYMENT_FAILED.user_action: Check wallet balance and gas fees

INSTALL_FAILED.description: npx install failed (package not found or npm error)
INSTALL_FAILED.agent_action: try alternative install method (pip, direct download)
INSTALL_FAILED.user_action: Check npm registry or GitHub repo

INSTALL_VERSION_MISMATCH.description: Installed version differs from audited version
INSTALL_VERSION_MISMATCH.agent_action: do not use — certificate is invalid for this version
INSTALL_VERSION_MISMATCH.user_action: Install the certified version specified in the certificate

TRUST_LOW.description: Skill trust score is below threshold
TRUST_LOW.agent_action: warn user, ask for explicit approval before proceeding
TRUST_LOW.user_action: Review the skill's audit report at /verify

TRUST_UNKNOWN.description: Skill has not been audited (no Sentinel certificate)
TRUST_UNKNOWN.agent_action: warn user that skill is unaudited, proceed with caution

SANDBOX_VIOLATION.description: Skill attempted blocked syscall (ptrace, bpf, mount, etc.)
SANDBOX_VIOLATION.agent_action: immediately stop and uninstall the skill

CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED.agent_action: check for updated certificate, use cached version if available

CERTIFICATE_INVALID.agent_action: do not install, report as potentially malicious

DEPENDENCY_MISSING.description: Required runtime dependency is not installed

SERVER_CRASHED.agent_action: check crash log, report to skill author
SERVER_CRASHED.user_action: Check if the skill is compatible with your runtime version

RATE_LIMITED.agent_action: back off and retry after delay specified in headers

on_failure.if: code starts with SBOX_ or CERT_002

on_failure.otherwise: log error, notify user with details
